text_block_list.text:
One day, while Мэдзиро Райан is doing
some
strength training in the gym...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oof... I can really feel that burn!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: My biceps are on fire! This is what a dumbbell workout is all about!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yep! With nothing but running on the
menu
lately, I've been neglecting my
upper body
workouts.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm focusing on my arms,
shoulders,
and back today, to give them
the attention
they—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Guess it's time for strength training.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I know I need to keep up with it... but
it's just so
hard.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, excuse me, Trainer. Just give me
a
minute!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nature! Why don't we train
together? If you
want to, that is.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, R-Ryan?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay, just a couple more reps! Keep it
going!
Twenty-eight!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: ...Twenty-nine! ...Thirty!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huff... Finally, I'm done! I don't think I could muster up the strength for even one more...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All right, great job! Those were some
real nice
push-ups!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Upper body strength is important for
swinging
your arms when running and
maintaining your
core, so working out
is—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Important, right? My teacher said so
too...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
YЭпизод But that's all just theory. The first
thing
about strength training is feeling it
with your own
body!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Can't you feel it right now? Those upper
arms feel
happy, don't they?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: ...You're asking if my arms are happy?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're kidding... right? All that my
arms
feel is tuckered out.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... They're tired, but actually... they
don't
feel half bad.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about! If you're
only
running, all those unused muscles
of yours will get
jealous and start
sulking.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But if you give them attention... then
they'll start
feelin' cheery, like they do
right now!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Come on, my muscles are cheery? Well, they certainly don't feel bad...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Haha! That's what makes working out
fun! I'll
teach you some other exercises
too!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
W-well... I guess seeing a few more
would be
okay.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Then next up we should...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: Let's keep pushing it to the limit!
You should teach her some theory first!

text_block_list.text:
You're right! The essence of muscle
training is to
go beyond the limits of
your own body.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You gotta know your limit today... so
you can
surpass yourself tomorrow!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Nature, it's going to be a little tough.
Think you
can keep up?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: My limit?! Wait, I wasn't really thinking about going that far...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, you can trust me! All
right, let's
do this!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: One for muscle, all for muscle!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: One for muscle, all for muscle!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Huh! Oh my, I just shouted... Wh-what's
gotten
into me?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You've got a major point. The right
workout
needs the right theory!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Okay, you two, let's do this. First, you
gotta
memorize the names of the
muscles and where
they are on your
body.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The muscles I'm flexing here... they're
the
rhomboids!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: The rhomboids! Got it!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: And here we have... the erector spinae!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: E-erector... s-spinae!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Very good! Let's make all the muscles in
our
bodies happy now!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Uh... How do I do that?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The pair continue to challenge
themselves to go
beyond their limits!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Soon after, Мэдзиро Райан's muscle training
method
becomes famous at the gym.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
